jobs.title: Process Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026 : Infosys Off Campus 2026 hiring fresher for Process Executive Role for BCom, BBA, Bachelor Of Education graduates and 2023 to 2026 graduates are eligible. The detailed company eligibility and application details are given below.  

About Infosys :

Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. Established in 1981, Infosys is a NYSE listed global consulting and IT services company with more than 250k employees. From a capital of US$250, we have grown to become a US$13.56 billion (Q4 FY21 revenues) company with a market capitalization of approximately US$79.74 billion.

Job Description :

Infosys is looking for a Process Executive in Pune / Mysore.

Job Title : Process Executive
Job Type : Full Time
Location : Pune / Mysore
Experience : Fresher – 1 Year

Responsibilities :
  • Deliver on day-to-day process targets in meeting Customer SLAs.
  • Should be able to work as per the provided client shift timings.
  • Follow the governance mechanism established with the client.
  • Execute transactions as per prescribed guidelines and timelines.
Education and Skills:
  • Proficiency in MS office application.
  • Willingness to work in business aligned shifts, Night Shift also (24*7).
  • Open to accept changes in work methods or systems to improve performance beyond agreed standards.
  • Mortgage knowledge is the added advantage.
  • 15 years of Graduation should be completed.
  • Knowledge on Banking / Mortgage / Insurance domain is Plus.
  • Graduation passout year 2023 to 2026 only.
  • Post Graduation passed out or Pursuing candidate will not be eligible for this role.
How To Apply Infosys Off Campus Drive 2026??  

All interested and eligible candidates can apply before expire in the following link.  

Apply Link :Click Here(Pune-Link1), Click Here(Pune- Link2), Click Here(Mysore)
